body: The new e2e suite introduces multiple `medium_planted` runs with the same seed (`crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:245-247`, `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:778-780`, `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:833-860`), but `HarnessRun::artifact_dir()` keys failure artifacts only by `scenario_id` and seed (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:546-553`). In a failing or parallel run, those tests all write to the same `/tmp/tank_harness/medium_planted_seed42` directory and can overwrite each other’s `trace.jsonl`, ledger, and metadata. Because `from_state()` still records the maintained variant as plain `medium_planted` (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:408-419`), the surviving artifact is also ambiguous. Give each harness run an explicit artifact/test label and include it in the artifact path/metadata.
